references.label: Center standup
references.description: The central standup below the upper playfield lights all three upper bumpers.
references.context: Hit the center standup target to light all three upper bumpers.

references.label: Upper bumpers
references.description: The three upper bumpers drive the main scoring route and create roto-target contacts.
references.context: Keep the ball moving through the upper bumpers.

references.label: Inner roto targets
references.description: The two inner rotating targets are reached through the bumper gap from the opposite upper flipper.
references.context: Use the opposite upper flipper for an inner roto target.

references.label: Outer roto targets
references.description: The two outer rotating targets sit above their same-side upper flippers.
references.context: Backhand the lit outer roto target from the upper flipper below it.
